about: an invite.send with assign already_connected: everyone unconnected is skipped (W17)

warnings.rule: settings.assign is already_connected, so anyone not already connected to a sending Account is skipped and this invitation never runs for them; use assign: auto
warnings.message: settings.assign is already_connected, so anyone not already connected to a sending Account is skipped and this invitation never runs for them; use assign: auto
warnings.hint: Set settings.assign to auto, the default: it prefers an Account already connected and invites everyone else. Keep already_connected only for a Motion that writes to existing Connections.
